segmentName: Electrostatic Precipitators & Transformer-Rectifier Sets (industrial pollution control / power electronics)

market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: ESP market: $8.98-9.4B (2024/25) to $12.25-12.7B by 2030 (5.2-6.4%/yr); one longer-horizon estimate reaches $18.48B by 2037 (6.5%/yr). Global TR (transformer-rectifier) market specifically: $1.94-2.1B (2025/26) to $2.66-3.67B by 2032-35 (4.6-6.4%/yr).
exportGeographies: 82 countries across 6 continents (per Ador Powertron's own claim)
globalCompetitors: Redkoh (precipitator-controls technology partner, US — described by Ador as the world's foremost precipitator-controls company, financials private)
market.domesticSlice: Asia-Pacific accounts for ~46% of the global TR market; dry ESP systems held ~70% share (2024), plate configuration 86.6% of installations

structureFacts: India's MoEF&CC has notified emission norms (SPM/SOx/NOx) for coal-based thermal power plants, mandating ESP/FGD/NOx-control technologies; the FGD retrofit program alone covers 440 power units totaling 166.5 GW capacity
Cement and steel industries face parallel particulate-emission compliance requirements driving ESP/TR retrofit demand
Equipment life-cycles run 10-30+ years, so order flow is driven by regulatory compliance deadlines and capex cycles, not repeat consumer-style purchasing

adoptionStructure.note: Not a repurchase category; demand is compliance-deadline and retrofit-cycle driven, with a long tail of spares/service revenue after initial installation

peers.name: Thermax Ltd
peers.note: air pollution control is one of several business lines alongside boilers/heaters/chillers/water treatment, not a pure-play comparable

drivers: regulatory compliance deadlines (SPM/SOx/NOx norms) are the primary driver for new installations and retrofits

steps: assess pollution-control need by plant type (power/cement/steel/pulp&paper)
customize ESP/TR system for boiler/kiln size, fuel type, emission target
in-house power-electronics design (rectifier/transformer engineering, control systems, high-voltage insulation)
scale for both new-build and large retrofit programs
after-sales/retrofit engineering service over the 10-30+ year equipment life
order flow driven by regulatory compliance deadlines and utility/industrial capex cycles
